title: Hacker News Who is Hiring Company Leads Input
description: Parse HN Who is Hiring threads into company leads. Pay per lead.

months.title: Number of recent months
months.description: How many recent 'Who is hiring' threads to include (1 = latest month).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Filter posts by text match (e.g. rust, react, ml, senior, fintech). Empty keeps all.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only posts that mention remote.

requireEmail.title: Only posts with an apply email
requireEmail.description: Skip posts that do not include a contact email.
